generation.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: native-detail opaque painted game background source panel, Meadow Entry Crossroads.
Input images: Image 1 is the single authoritative exact-coordinate control crop for Crossroads: route geometry, biome mouths, building/transition/protected/semantic masks, and live handoff pads. Image 2 is secondary color/composition guidance only from the approved concept crop.
Primary request: paint a crisp hand-painted 2D JRPG top-down ground-only environment panel for fixed Meadow master-coordinate bounds x=2880..4608, y=2816..4768, exact output aspect 1728x1952. Build a neutral warm cobble-and-packed-earth plaza centered around an EMPTY live Waystone footprint; show clear radial route wear from the plaza, subtle low cobble color-mottling and packed-earth variation, and restrained biome cues at the route mouths (cool mistfen tint, russet silverpine tint, deep wildwood green, warm Sundrop handoff). Use painted ground-plane variation only, with a calm NPC/interaction space.
Composition/framing: orthographic top-down ground only; preserve every route and handoff in Image 1, especially the village connector along the south and open approach throats. The exact center waystone/anchor/interaction pad must be a quiet flat empty plaza patch—no waystone, stone, statue, marker, or false obstacle. Keep all buildings, doors, transitions, NPC/encounter/pickup/discovery/spawn pads, collision clearances, and corridor masks unobstructed and navigable. Side edges must hand off without hard seams to their live neighboring regions.
Lighting/mood: warm late-morning upper-left, readable value hierarchy, crisp native-detail painted texture, no blur.
Constraints: opaque sRGB/RGBA raster; exact fixed framing; no buildings, roofs, architecture, doors, windows, walls, fences, actors, NPCs, enemies, pickups, signs, text, labels, UI, icons, waystones, statues, boulders, bridges, props, tall objects, false walls, false collision cues, or baked duplicate live visuals. No repeated grid, tile seams, perspective distortion, watermark.
Avoid: isometric/three-quarter structures, hard rectangular biome bands, blocked route mouths, object silhouettes, obvious generator seams, excessive cobble detail inside the live waystone pad.
